QuestInfo.name: Friends With Same Heart and Mind!
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Administrator has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.1:
A lot of adventurers in Maple World are teaming up these days. 
It's really quite inspiring! 
Maybe you should give it a try, and team up with some friends.
See if anyone wants to be your Sidekick, and work together!
QuestInfo.2: Great, you got your own Sidekick. You should try hunting monsters with your new friend. If you collect a whole bunch of [Sidekick Emblems], I bet you'll get a nice surprise!
